walkthroughs.body_html:
Variation → competition → survival → reproduction.

Mutations create new alleles. Individuals with helpful alleles survive and pass them on.

Choose parents with the trait; breed them; choose offspring; repeat.

Used in farming: high-yield crops, meaty cattle, disease-resistant wheat. Risk: narrow gene pool.

Cut a useful gene out with restriction enzymes. Insert into a plasmid using ligase. Transfer into bacteria.

Examples: insulin in bacteria, golden rice, herbicide-resistant crops.

mcqs.q: How does a population of organisms become better adapted to its environment over time?
options: Individual organisms change during their lifetime in response to their environment and pass the changes on to offspring.
Individuals with advantageous heritable variations survive and reproduce more; their alleles increase in frequency over generations.
Each gene codes for an organ or body part as a whole.
Organisms decide what features they need and grow them by force of will.

mcqs.q: What does a gene code for?
options: Organisms decide what features they need and grow them by force of will.
Each gene codes for an organ or body part as a whole.
A gene codes for a specific physical feature like eye colour directly.
Typically a polypeptide (protein) — through transcription to mRNA and translation by ribosomes.
Each gene codes for an organ or body part as a whole.
Mutations only happen in organisms that have been damaged by external chemicals.
They are random changes in DNA — caused by errors in replication or by mutagens — not directed by need.
Mutations occur because organisms need to adapt to their environment.

A population of insects is sprayed with insecticide. A few survive and breed, and after several generations most insects survive the spray. Which conclusion is best supported?
options: Resistant individuals survived and passed on the resistance allele.
The insects learned to resist during their lifetime.
The insecticide created resistance in every insect.
The insects chose to become resistant.

mcqs.q: In genetic modification a useful gene is inserted into a bacterium using a plasmid. The plasmid acts as a:
options: Vector to carry the gene into the cell
Enzyme to cut the DNA
Source of energy for the cell
Protein the gene codes for

mcqs.q: Restriction enzymes are used in genetic engineering to:
options: Cut DNA at specific base sequences

Build proteins from amino acids
Copy whole chromosomes

mcqs.q: Darwin's theory of evolution by natural selection was supported by which type of evidence?
options: The fossil record showing change over time
Organisms choosing their own adaptations
Identical offspring in all species
